releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.1
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.1 updates the bundled AnyPS5 core from v0.1.2 to **[v0.1.4](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/releases/tag/v0.1.4)**.

## Changes
- **AnyPS5 core v0.1.4**: the bundled relinker and system libraries now come from the latest upstream release. Existing installs switch to it automatically the next time Studio starts, and each game receives the new libraries on its next launch.
- **Relink hint**: Studio now remembers which core relinked each game. If a game was relinked with an earlier core, the launch log says so and suggests relinking it in Relinker Studio if it fails to start.
- **Verified core downloads**: the bundled core is checked against the SHA-256 checksums AnyPS5 publishes for the release; a mismatch stops the build.
- The NID inspector's "Python 3 not found" message now points to the correct re-audit button.

## After updating
If a game that worked before no longer starts, open **Relinker Studio** and relink it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ramsforge/AnyPS5-Studio/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

## Persona 5 Royal Android Recomp v0.5.12

### Español
- **Ocultar controles en pantalla:** Se añadió la opción en el Launcher (`NX_TOUCH_HIDE`) para ocultar los controles visuales. Los controles siguen 100% activos y funcionales al tocar la pantalla, ideal para quienes prefieren la pantalla limpia o juegan con memoria muscular.

- **Corrección de cuelgues de GPU (GPU Hangs):** Se deshabilitaron las divisiones de renderpass a mitad de pase (`NX_CHUNK_IN_PASS=0`) por defecto en GPUs TBDR (Adreno 830 / Mali).
- **Corrección de texto en mensajes (IM / SNS Chat):** Se corrigió el renderizado del texto en las opciones de respuesta del chat del teléfono móvil (PR #251).
- **Renderizado de plantillas (Stencil Front/Back):** Se unificó el estado del stencil en viewports invertidos.
- **Estabilidad en cinemáticas:** Mejoras en alineación de filas y sincronización de video en procesadores Qualcomm y Exynos.

---

### English
- **Hide On-Screen Controls:** Added option in the Launcher (`NX_TOUCH_HIDE`) to hide the on-screen touch overlay. Touch controls remain fully active and responsive under your fingers while staying invisible.
- **Fixed Play crash on startup:** Safe JNI pointer and storage access checks in `android_main`, preventing SIGSEGV crashes on devices booting from direct NSP/FD (POCO X7 Pro, POCO F6, etc.).
- **Fixed "Preparing game" freeze:** Clamped shader translation worker jobs to a maximum of 4 during import, preventing infinite hangs on MediaTek Dimensity 8350 chips.
- **Fixed GPU Hangs on TBDR:** Disabled mid-pass render

## Persona 5 Royal Android v0.5.11

### Fixes & Improvements / Correcciones y mejoras
- **Audio resume on sleep/lock screen (Fixes #238):**
  Automatically recreates the AAudio stream when disconnected, restoring game sound upon waking or unlocking the phone.
  *Se re-crea automáticamente el flujo de audio de AAudio al desconectarse, restaurando el sonido del juego al desbloquear o reanudar el teléfono.*
- **UI stripes and color banding on tile-based GPUs (Fixes #243):**
  Fixed bound pipeline and dynamic state cache invalidation on render pass end, preventing dull colors and white stripes in menus and dialogue on Adreno, Mali, and PowerVR.
  *Se corrigió la invalidación del estado dinámico y pipelines al finalizar un pase de renderizado, solucionando colores apagados y franjas blancas en la interfaz.*
- **Qualcomm Snapdragon cutscene video alignment (PR #245):**
  Applied proper row alignment independently of stride for Qualcomm hardware decoders, fixing green and distorted lines during opening cutscenes.
  *Alineación de filas independiente de stride para decodificadores Qualcomm, eliminando líneas verdes y distorsiones en cinemáticas.*
- **PowerVR title screen stability:**
  Resolved crashes after the opening movie on PowerVR GPUs (e.g. Moto G54).
  *Estabilidad en la pantalla de título tras la cinemática de apertura en GPUs PowerVR.*

## 1.1.3 (2026-11)

### Fixes
- **Fast precision is as light as the older versions again.** Its pixel
  shaders still did per-pixel work added for the exact mode (rounding every
  step to the console's bytes, holding coordinates on texel edges, a pass
  per sample on antialiased surfaces), which made full-screen effects up to
  half again as expensive. At higher internal resolutions on integrated and
  older GPUs that was the difference between full speed and half
  (Midnight Club 3 at 3x). Fast now costs the same as 1.0.104 or less.
- Fast precision: stray lines over Vice City's buildings.
- Log lines and environment variables say xbased (`XBASED_*`; the older
  `HAKUX_*` names still work). For LAN play every machine needs 1.1.3.

releases.body:
## 1.1.2 (2026-11)

### New
- **GPU precision** (Settings › System, or per game): **Exact** draws with
  the console graphics chip's own arithmetic, the closest to a real Xbox and
  the heaviest on the GPU; **Fast** uses plain float shaders, as xbased did
  up to 1.0.94, much lighter on the GPU. **Automatic**, the
  default, picks Fast on AMD Polaris and Vega cards and Vega integrated
  graphics (their driver crashed building the exact shaders), on CPUs of 4
  threads or fewer, and from the next run on a GPU that crashed building a
  shader, took too long to build the exact ones or could not keep up with
  them; Exact everywhere else. The setting's help shows what Automatic
  chose last and why.
- **Cached shaders built before the game** is on by default, in both
  precisions.

### Fixes
- No more shader stutter on GPUs without pipeline libraries (AMD's Windows
  driver, older Intel drivers): the hybrid mode can't run there and fell
  back to synchronous builds, pausing the game for every new shader; it now
  builds them in the background.
- On CPUs with few threads, shader builds no longer take time from the
  game: they run below its threads and only on the threads it leaves free

# Steam64 setup, one step at a time

**Experimental prerelease · Build145 · Known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit. This update improves setup; it does not fix that stability issue.**

## What’s new

[![Patreon](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Support_on_Patreon-FF424D?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership)

**Xenra 0.4.0** brings a main-thread responsiveness pass, custom Vulkan driver support for Exynos (Mali) devices, experimental temporal frame generation, FATX save streaming, and the consolidation of Xenra into a single free build.

---

## Upgrade Notice

* **Install Direct:** Install Xenra 0.4.0 directly over your existing Green installation. Do not uninstall first, or your configurations, profiles, and shader caches will be deleted.
* **Gold Edition Discontinued:** Gold is retired as of 0.4.0. Installing Green (`Ali.Xanite.green`) will install alongside Gold. Gold data remains intact on your device, but a one-time setup (selecting BIOS, game paths, and granting storage permissions) is required on Green.

---

* **Touch & D-Pad Navigation:** Touch target resolution defers to `ACTION_UP` without walking full view trees. D-pad navigation eliminates ~170 filesystem probes per press for instant library scrolling.
* **Background Log Parsing:** `xe.log` parsing, crash log

# Xenra 0.3.6

[![Gold Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Patreon-Gold_Version-FF424D?style=for-the-badge&logo=patreon)](https://www.patreon.com/cw/Xanite/membership)

**Xenra 0.3.6** introduces major compatibility, performance, and usability improvements, including GTA V gameplay, frame generation across both Xbox generations, improved GPU handling, save importing, and crucial Xbox 360 fixes.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Upgrade Notice:** Install Xenra 0.3.6 directly over your existing installation. **Do not uninstall the previous version**, or your configurations, profiles, and shader caches will be deleted.

---

##  Highlights

###  Gameplay & Performance
* **GTA V:** Resolved the `NetDll_select` scheduling issue that caused the black-screen hang. GTA V now reaches gameplay at ~25 FPS in initial testing.
* **Frame Generation:** Added frame generation support for both Original Xbox and Xbox 360, featuring **1.25×**, **1.5×**, and **2×** performance modes.
* **Core Performance:** Optimized compiled-code synchronization and streamlined several frequently executed code paths.

###  Graphics & System Settings
* **GPU Driver Persistence:** System GPU driver selection now correctly persists

Access the dedicated **Game Data** menu by long-pressing any title in your library:

* **Xbox 360 Patches & Mods:** Direct installation of `.patch.toml` files (with Title ID verification) and `.xex` plugins via `plugins.toml`.
* **Xbox 360 Saves:** View saves grouped by profile; import and export ZIP archives.
* **Original Xbox Saves:** Direct FATX hard disk image integration. List, import, export, and delete saves with synchronized `UDATA` and `TDATA` handling.

## Xenra 0.5.0

### A new platform: iOS

Xenra ships on iPad and iPhone for the first time, as one app with both
consoles:

- Xbox 360 and original Xbox cores, the Metal renderer, JIT through StikDebug,
  and the floating pad with physical controller support.
- Dashboard, game library with box art and covers, setup wizard, per-game
  settings, sharing logs, crash and thermal reports.
- Xbox 360 System Link netplay over the local network, with a signed-in profile.
- Original Xbox Live through Insignia: console DNS, setup assistant and the
  retail dashboard, all from the app.

The iOS and Android screens share their wording and layout, so a guide written
for one applies to the other.

The Performance core is the default original Xbox core on Android, chosen per
game at launch. xemu remains for the dashboard, the Insignia setup assistant and
the games the performance core cannot run, exactly the split the game menu
already understands. The core names in the library and per-game settings are now
